context.title: Ready, Faithful and Merciful
context.summary: Three pictures of the end: ten bridesmaids waiting for a bridegroom, servants entrusted with talents, and the Son of Man separating sheep from goats by how they treated 'the least of these'.
context.background: This chapter finishes Jesus' last major teaching block, given just days before his arrest. Each scene is about how to live while waiting for the King's return. The final scene shows the Son of Man as judge of 'all nations' (v. 32).

customs.note: The bridegroom came, often at night, to bring his bride home, and friends with lamps joined the procession and feast. A lamp needed oil to last.
A large weight of silver, about 6,000 days' wages. Even one talent was a great sum.

watchFor: All ten bridesmaids sleep; the difference is preparation (v. 5).
The faithful servants hear the same praise despite different amounts (vv. 21, 23).
Both sheep and goats are surprised by the verdict (vv. 37, 44).

people.name: Jesus
people.also: Immanuel, Emmanuel, Messiah, Shiloh, Christ, Jesus Christ, Messias
people.summary: Anointed, the Greek translation of the Hebrew word rendered “Messiah”, the official title of our Lord, occurring five hundred and fourteen times in the New Testament.
